```{python}
#| label: fig-fp6-duplex-q
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Duplex gap $f_\\mathrm{gap}$ between uplink and downlink (left) and the resulting lower bound $Q_\\mathrm{min} = f_\\mathrm{c} / f_\\mathrm{gap}$ of the filter quality factor (right) for the FDD bands of the Fairphone (Gen. 6). The shaded area marks the $Q$ of on-chip $LC$ filters (10 to 20)."
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'content/fp6')
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import fp6_bands as fb

bands = sorted(fb.FDD, key=fb.center)
fc = np.array([fb.center(b) for b in bands])
gap = np.array([fb.duplex_gap(b) for b in bands])
q_min = fc / gap
labels = [f'B{b}' for b in bands]
group_colors = {'LB': 'tab:blue', 'MB': 'tab:orange', 'HB': 'tab:green'}
colors = [group_colors[fb.group(f)] for f in fc]

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(9, 3.8), sharey=True)
y = np.arange(len(bands))

ax1.barh(y, gap, color=colors)
for yi, g in zip(y, gap):
    ax1.text(g * 1.08, yi, f'{g:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=8)
ax1.set_xscale('log')
ax1.set_xlim(5, 1000)
ax1.set_xlabel('Duplex gap $f_\\mathrm{gap}$ (MHz)')
ax1.set_yticks(y)
ax1.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)

ax2.barh(y, q_min, color=colors)
for yi, q in zip(y, q_min):
    ax2.text(q * 1.08, yi, f'{q:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=8)
ax2.axvspan(10, 20, color='tab:red', alpha=0.15)
ax2.text(14, -0.7, 'on-chip $LC$', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='tab:red')
ax2.set_ylim(len(bands) - 0.5, -1.2)
ax2.set_xscale('log')
ax2.set_xlim(3, 1000)
ax2.set_xlabel('$Q_\\mathrm{min} = f_\\mathrm{c} / f_\\mathrm{gap}$')
ax2.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)

handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color=c) for c in group_colors.values()]
ax2.legend(handles, list(group_colors), loc='lower right', fontsize=8)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
